interactionMap.static: No component hover/pressed state; only the nested Button owns interaction states.
interactionMap.retry: Disable or show loading on the action while a retry is in flight; preserve the user's current context.
interactionMap.search: NotFound action clears or adjusts filters without discarding unrelated page state.
interactionMap.permission: Show an action only when a real permission request/contact route exists.
interactionMap.dynamic: Announce a newly produced empty result politely; avoid duplicate Toast/Alert announcements.

accessibility.illustration: Use alt='' and aria-hidden=true when title/description already carry the meaning.
accessibility.announcement: Static state needs no live region. For post-action results, use role=status or aria-live=polite on the message container.
accessibility.error: Use role=alert only for an urgent failure that requires immediate attention; ordinary retryable empty errors remain polite.
accessibility.focus: Do not focus the illustration. Preserve focus on the initiating control or the available recovery action.
